spells.name: Animate Dead
spells.description: Raise a Skeleton or Zombie from bones or a corpse. Control it for 24 hours. Use a Bonus Action to command it. Reassert control over up to four creatures by recasting.

spells.name: Aura of Vitality
spells.description: Healing energy radiates from you. Until the spell ends, use a Bonus Action to cause a creature in the aura to regain 2d6 HP.

spells.name: Beacon of Hope
spells.description: Chosen creatures have Advantage on Wisdom and Death saves and regain maximum HP from healing.

spells.name: Bestow Curse
spells.description: Touch a creature and force a Wisdom save. Fail: target is cursed. Choose: Disadvantage on checks/saves of one ability; Disadvantage on attacks against you; Wisdom save at start of turn or do nothing; or your attacks deal +1d8 Necrotic damage.

spells.name: Blinding Smite
spells.description: Next melee hit deals extra 3d8 Radiant damage and target must succeed on a Constitution save or be Blinded until the spell ends (repeat save at end of turns).

spells.name: Blink
spells.description: Roll a d20 at the end of each turn. 11+: vanish to Ethereal Plane. Start of your next turn: return to space within 10ft of where you vanished. While Ethereal, you can see/hear the origin plane (60ft) but can only affect/be affected by those on the Ethereal Plane.

spells.name: Call Lightning
spells.description: Thundercloud cylinder (10ft tall, 60ft radius). Action: lightning strike on a point. Creatures within 5ft make a Dexterity save or take 3d10 Lightning damage (half on success). +1d10 damage if cast in an existing storm.
spells.upcast: +1d10 damage in storms.

spells.name: Clairvoyance
spells.description: Create an invisible sensor in a familiar or obvious location. Choose seeing or hearing. Action to switch senses. Visible to See Invisibility/Truesight.

spells.name: Conjure Animals
spells.description: Conjure nature spirits in a Large pack. You have Advantage on Strength saves within 5ft. Move pack 30ft on your turn. Creatures entering or starting turns within 10ft make a Dexterity save or take 3d10 Slashing damage (once/turn).
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d10 for each level above 3.

spells.name: Conjure Barrage
spells.description: Spectral copies of your weapon launch in a 60ft cone. Each chosen creature makes a Dexterity save. Fail: 5d8 Force damage. Success: half damage.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d8 for each level above 3.

spells.name: Conjure Constructs
spells.description: Conjure intangible spirits. Magic action (including when cast): command spirits to target a creature within 5ft: (1) Clockwork Force (Dex save or 3d6 Force damage, half on success) or (2) Orderly Ward (Target gains 1d6 + spellcasting modifier Temp HP). Move spirits 30ft when you move.
spells.upcast: Damage and Temp HP increase by 1d6 for each level above 3.

spells.name: Counterspell
spells.description: Interrupt a creature casting a spell. Target makes a Constitution save. Fail: spell dissipates with no effect. Success: spell works. Slot is not expended if the spell fails.

spells.name: Create Food and Water
spells.description: Create 45 lbs of food and 30 gallons of water. Food spoils after 24 hours.

spells.name: Crusader's Mantle
spells.description: Radiate an aura. You and allies in the aura deal an extra 1d4 Radiant damage when hitting with weapon/unarmed attacks.

spells.name: Daylight
spells.description: 60ft-radius Sphere of sunlight (Bright, +60ft Dim). Dispels Darkness spells of level 3 or lower. Can center on an object as an Emanation.

spells.name: Dispel Magic
spells.description: End spells of level 3 or lower on target. For higher level spells, make an ability check (DC 10 + spell level) to end them.
spells.upcast: Automatically end spells of level equal to or lower than the slot used.

spells.name: Elemental Weapon
spells.description: Nonmagical weapon gains +1 to attack and +1d4 damage (Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder).
spells.upcast: +2 bonus and 2d4 damage (L5-6); +3 bonus and 3d4 damage (L7+).

spells.name: Fear
spells.description: Each creature in 30ft cone makes a Wisdom save. Fail: drop held objects and Frightened; must take Dash action to move away. Repeat save if it ends turn with no line of sight.

spells.name: Feign Death
spells.description: Willing creature enters cataleptic state: Blinded, Incapacitated, 0 Speed. Resistance to all but Psychic, immune to Poisoned.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.description: 20ft-radius Sphere explosion. Each creature makes a Dexterity save. Fail: 8d6 Fire damage. Success: half damage. Flammable objects ignite. Cover provides normal protection.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 3.

spells.name: Fly
spells.description: Touch willing creature: it gains 60ft Fly Speed and can hover.
spells.upcast: Target one additional creature for each level above 3.

spells.name: Gaseous Form
spells.description: Touch willing creature: becomes misty cloud. 10ft Fly Speed (hover), can enter other spaces/narrow gaps. Resistance to physical damage, immune to Prone, Adv on Str/Dex/Con saves. Cannot talk, attack, or cast.
spells.upcast: Target one additional creature for each level above 3.

spells.name: Glyph of Warding
spells.description: Inscribe trigger on surface/object. Choose: (1) Explosive Rune (20ft Sphere, 5d8 Acid/Cold/Fire/Lightning/Thunder, Dex save for half), or (2) Spell Glyph (store L3- spell cast when triggered).
spells.upcast: Damage +1d8 per level above 3; store higher level spells.

spells.name: Haste
spells.description: Willing creature: Speed doubled, +2 AC, Adv on Dex saves, additional action (1 attack, Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Utilize). When ends: Incapacitated and 0 Speed for 1 turn.

spells.name: Hunger of Hadar
spells.description: 20ft-radius Sphere of darkness (Difficult Terrain, Blinded). Creature starting turn there takes 2d6 Cold damage. Ending turn there: Dexterity save or 2d6 Acid damage.
spells.upcast: Cold or Acid damage increases by 1d6 per level above 3.

spells.name: Hypnotic Pattern
spells.description: 30ft Cube pattern. Each creature makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed, Incapacitated, and has 0 Speed. Ends if damaged or shaken as an action.

spells.name: Leomund's Tiny Hut
spells.description: 10ft dome. Creatures/objects inside cast can move through. Spells of L3- cannot pass through. Comfortable and dim/dark light control. Ends if you leave.

spells.name: Lightning Arrow
spells.description: Weapon/ammunition becomes lightning. Target takes 4d8 Lightning damage on hit (half on miss). Target and creatures within 10ft make a Dexterity save or take 2d8 Lightning damage (half on success).
spells.upcast: Both damages increase by 1d8 per level above 3.

spells.name: Lightning Bolt
spells.description: 100ft long, 5ft wide Line of lightning. Each creature in line makes a Dexterity save or takes 8d6 Lightning damage (half on success). Ignites flammable objects.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d6 per level above 3.

spells.name: Magic Circle
spells.description: Create 10ft-radius, 20ft-tall Cylinder. Choose Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, or Undead. Target creatures can't willingly enter/leave, have Disadvantage on attacks vs those inside, and can't Charm/Frighten/Possess them.
spells.upcast: Duration increases by 1 hour per level above 3.

spells.name: Major Image
spells.description: Create 20ft Cube visual illusion (+sound, smell, temp). Magic action to move it. Physical interaction or Study action vs spell DC reveals it as an illusion.
spells.upcast: L4+ slot: Duration is 'Until Dispelled' and no Concentration.

spells.name: Mass Healing Word
spells.description: Up to six creatures in range regain 2d4 + spellcasting modifier HP. No effect on Undead/Constructs.
spells.upcast: Healing increases by 1d4 per level above 3.

spells.name: Meld into Stone
spells.description: Merge gear and self into stone. Undetectable by nonmagical senses (Disadv on hearing outside). Minor stone damage doesn't hurt; partial destruction deals 6d6 Force; complete destruction deals 50 Force and expels you.

spells.name: Nondetection
spells.description: Target (creature/place/object up to 10ft) cannot be targeted by Divination magic or scrying sensors.

spells.name: Phantom Steed
spells.description: Summon Large horselike creature (Speed 100ft). Fades over 1 minute when spell ends. Ends early if it takes any damage.

spells.name: Plant Growth
spells.description: **Overgrowth (Action):** Plants in 100ft radius make movement cost 4ft per 1ft. **Enrichment (8 Hours):** Plants in 0.5 mile radius yield 2x food for 1 year.

spells.name: Protection from Energy
spells.description: Willing creature gains Resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder.

spells.name: Remove Curse
spells.description: All curses on a creature/object end. Cursed magic items remain cursed but the spell breaks owner's Attunement.

spells.name: Revivify
spells.description: Touch creature dead for <1 minute; it returns to life with 1 HP. Cannot restore body parts or old age.

spells.name: Sending
spells.description: Send message (max 25 words) to familiar creature. Can respond immediately. Works across planes (5% fail). Recipient can block you for 8 hours.

spells.name: Sleet Storm
spells.description: 40ft-tall, 20ft-radius Cylinder. Area is Heavily Obscured and Difficult Terrain; douses flames. Creatures entering/starting turns make a Dexterity save or fall Prone and lose Concentration.

spells.name: Slow
spells.description: Up to six creatures in 40ft Cube make a Wisdom save. Fail: half Speed, -2 AC/Dex saves, no Reactions. Can only take Action OR Bonus Action (not both) and max 1 attack. Spells with Somatic components have 25% failure chance.

spells.name: Speak with Dead
spells.description: Corpse can answer 5 questions (based on what it knew in life). Not compelled to be truthful to enemies. Fails if Undead or cast on in last 10 days.

spells.name: Speak with Plants
spells.description: Question plants about last 24 hours. Change plant-based Difficult Terrain. Communicate with Plant creatures.

spells.name: Spirit Guardians
spells.description: Spirits halve enemy Speed in aura. When area enters enemy space or they enter/end turn there: Wisdom save for 3d8 Radiant (Good/Neutral) or Necrotic (Evil) damage (half on success).
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d8 per level above 3.

spells.name: Stinking Cloud
spells.description: 20ft-radius Sphere of gas (Heavily Obscured). Creatures starting turns make a Constitution save or be Poisoned (can't take Action/Bonus Action) until end of turn.

spells.name: Summon Fey
spells.description: Summon a Fey spirit (Fuming, Mirthful, or Tricksy). Shares your initiative (acts after you). Has a Fey Step teleport with a secondary effect.
spells.upcast: Stat block scales with spell level.

spells.name: Summon Undead
spells.description: Summon an Undead spirit (Ghostly, Putrid, or Skeletal). Shares your initiative (acts after you). Each form has unique traits (Frightening touch, Poisonous aura, or Ranged bolts).
spells.upcast: Stat block scales with spell level.

spells.name: Tongues
spells.description: Target understands any spoken/signed language; any creature knowing a language understands the target's speech/signs.

spells.name: Vampiric Touch
spells.description: Melee spell attack deals 3d6 Necrotic damage; you heal half. Use a Magic action on later turns to repeat.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d6 per level above 3.

spells.name: Water Breathing
spells.description: Up to ten willing creatures can breathe underwater.

spells.name: Water Walk
spells.description: Up to ten willing creatures move across any liquid as solid ground. Submerged creatures rise at 60ft/round.

spells.name: Wind Wall
spells.description: Create wall (50ft long, 15ft high, 1ft thick). Creatures in area make Strength save or take 4d8 Bludgeoning damage (half on success). Wall blocks gases, small flying creatures, and auto-deflects arrows/bolts.

spells.name: Catnap
spells.description: Touch up to three willing creatures. They fall Unconscious for 10 minutes. If they finish the full duration, they gain the benefits of a Short Rest.

spells.name: Enemies Abound
spells.description: Force an Intelligence save. Fail: target cannot distinguish friend from foe. Must choose targets for attacks/spells at random from visible creatures. Repeat save on damage.

spells.name: Erupting Earth
spells.description: Eruption in a 20ft Cube. Each creature makes a Dexterity save. Fail: 3d12 Bludgeoning damage and area becomes Difficult Terrain. Success: half damage.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d12 for each level above 3.

spells.name: Flame Arrows
spells.description: Touch a quiver of up to 12 pieces of ammunition. Hit deals extra 1d6 Fire damage.

spells.name: Life Transference
spells.description: You take 4d8 Necrotic damage (ignores Resistance/Immunity). One creature within range heals HP equal to twice the damage you took.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d8 for each level above 3.

spells.name: Melf's Minute Meteors
spells.description: Create 6 Tiny meteors. Bonus Action: launch 1 or 2 meteors to a point within 120ft. 5ft-radius Sphere makes a Dexterity save or takes 2d6 Fire damage (half on success).
spells.upcast: Create 2 more meteors for each level above 3.

spells.name: Summon Lesser Demons
spells.description: Summon 1d8 Manes/Dretches (CR 1/4 or lower) or other amounts based on higher CRs. They are hostile to all creatures.

spells.name: Thunder Step
spells.description: Teleport up to 90ft. Creatures within 10ft of departure make a Constitution save or take 3d10 Thunder damage (half on success). Can bring one willing creature.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d10 for each level above 3.

spells.name: Tidal Wave
spells.description: Conjure a wave (30ft long, 10ft wide, 10ft high). Each creature in area makes a Dexterity save. Fail: 4d8 Bludgeoning damage and knocked Prone. Success: half damage and not Prone.

spells.name: Tiny Servant
spells.description: Touch Tiny nonmagical object to create a Construct (AC 15, 10 HP, 30ft speed, 60ft blindsight). Obeys mental commands (Bonus Action).
spells.upcast: Create two additional servants for each level above 3.

spells.name: Wall of Sand
spells.description: Create a wall of sand (30ft long, 10ft high, 10ft thick). Heavily Obscured area; moving through costs 3ft per 1ft.

spells.name: Wall of Water
spells.description: Create a wall of water (30ft long, 10ft high, 1ft thick). Difficult Terrain. Ranged attacks through it have Disadvantage and half damage. Fire damage through it is halved. Cold damage can freeze sections (AC 5, 15 HP).

spells.name: Intellect Fortress
spells.description: Target gains Resistance to Psychic damage and Advantage on Int, Wis, and Cha saves.
spells.upcast: Target one additional creature for each level above 3.

spells.name: Spirit Shroud
spells.description: Attacks against creatures within 10ft deal extra 1d8 damage (Cold, Necrotic, or Radiant). Target Speed reduced by 10ft. Hit creature can't regain HP until its next turn.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d8 for every two levels above 3.

spells.name: Summon Shadowspawn
spells.description: Summon a Shadow Spirit (Fury, Despair, or Fear). It shares your initiative (acts after you). Stat block scales with level.
spells.upcast: Stat block scales with spell level.

spells.name: Ashardalon's Stride
spells.description: Speed increases by 20ft; movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks. Moving within 5ft of a creature/object deals 1d6 Fire damage (once per turn).
spells.upcast: Speed +5ft and damage +1d6 per level above 3.

spells.name: Pulse Wave
spells.description: 30ft cone. Each creature makes a Constitution save. Fail: 6d6 Force damage and pushed or pulled 15ft. Success: half damage and no movement.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 3.
